## ClaudeMC v1.4

**Minecraft:** 1.21.1 · **Fabric Loader:** 0.16.5 · **Fabric API:** 0.100.7+1.21.1 · **Java:** 21

### New in v1.4

#### AuctionDupe
Automates auction-house race-condition exploits targeting unpatched AH plugins on Spigot/Bukkit.

Three techniques selectable in module settings (right-click AuctionDupe in the ClickGUI):

| Technique | How |
|---|---|
| **WindowClose** | Sends rapid `CloseHandledScreenC2SPacket`s while cancel-confirm screen is open — item returned before cancel finalises |
| **DoubleCancel** | N rapid slot-click packets on the confirm button in one tick — thread-unsafe plugins process multiple returns |
| **Reconnect** | Closes screen (triggers server-side item return) then disconnects immediately — item stays, listing may also be refunded |

**How to use:**
1. Open auction house → navigate to your listed item's Cancel / Retrieve screen
2. Enable **AuctionDupe** in the Misc panel (`.` → Misc → AuctionDupe)
3. Fires automatically after 3 ticks then self-disables — re-toggle to repeat

**Patched on:** AuctionHouse 1.3.6+, Paper-patched GUIs, plugins with synchronous atomic item commits.

#### Workflow fix
- GitHub Actions updated to Node.js 24 — eliminates the Node.js 20 deprecation warning.
